requirements.quote: Quote-token amounts use raw six-decimal units.
requirements.checkable: Quote-token amounts are expressed in raw units with 1,000,000 units per whole token.
Basis-point calculations use Math.mulDiv with rounding toward the lower integer.

requirements.quote: the sponsor receives the remaining raw units after winner and protocol allocations.
requirements.checkable: After winner and protocol allocations, the sponsor receives all remaining raw units.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Denominator used for every global protocol basis-point rate.
    uint256 internal constant BPS = 10_000;
requirements.checkable: Every global protocol basis-point rate uses a denominator of 10,000.

requirements.quote: Global protocol fee rate: 500 basis points, or 5% of gross sales.
requirements.checkable: The global protocol fee is calculated at 500/10,000 of gross sales.

requirements.quote: Cash-result winner rate: 8,000 basis points, or 80% of gross sales.
requirements.checkable: The cash-result winner allocation is calculated at 8,000/10,000 of gross sales.

requirements.quote: Global entry price: exactly 1,000,000 raw six-decimal quote-token units, or one USDC.
requirements.checkable: Every v1 entry costs exactly 1,000,000 raw six-decimal quote-token units.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Decimal precision required from the immutable quote token.
    uint8 internal constant QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS = 6;
requirements.checkable: The quote token has exactly six decimal places.

requirements.quote: Decimal precision required from the immutable quote token.
requirements.checkable: The quote token is immutable after deployment.
A refund execution processes at most 100 tickets, with the bound measured in tickets.

requirements.quote: each ticket may represent any uint128 entry count.
requirements.checkable: Each ticket can represent any uint128 entry count.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Maximum prospective raffle sale duration, measured from creation to the exclusive sale end.
    uint256 internal constant MAX_SALE_DURATION = 30 days;
requirements.checkable: The prospective interval from raffle creation to sale end cannot exceed 30 days.

requirements.quote: Maximum prospective raffle sale duration, measured from creation to the exclusive sale end.
requirements.checkable: The sale-end timestamp is excluded from the period in which entries may be sold.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Duration after sale end during which a sold raffle may initiate its draw, in seconds.
    uint256 internal constant DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 2 days;
requirements.checkable: A sold raffle has a two-day draw-initiation window starting at sale end.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Duration after an accepted request during which its authenticated callback may resolve, in seconds.
    uint256 internal constant DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT = 2 days;
requirements.checkable: An authenticated callback has a two-day resolution window starting at acceptance of its draw request.

requirements.quote: Duration after an accepted request during which its authenticated callback may resolve, in seconds.
requirements.checkable: Only authenticated callbacks are allowed to resolve an accepted draw request.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Gas-unit limit requested for the single-word Chainlink callback.
    uint32 internal constant VRF_CALLBACK_GAS_LIMIT = 300_000;
requirements.checkable: Requests specify a Chainlink callback gas limit of 300,000 gas units.

requirements.quote: Gas-unit limit requested for the single-word Chainlink callback.
requirements.checkable: The Chainlink VRF callback is configured to return a single word.

requirements.quote:
/// @notice Block confirmations requested from Chainlink before callback fulfillment.
    uint16 internal constant VRF_REQUEST_CONFIRMATIONS = 30;
requirements.checkable: Chainlink requests specify 30 block confirmations before callback fulfillment.
